description: Distrofy Chat helps Distrofy artists check their account, releases, artists, labels, wallet, streaming analytics, subscription, and support tickets from ChatGPT. Connect with your Distrofy artist account to see how many releases you have, review draft or pending releases, manage or view artist and label profiles, understand validation issues, check wallet balances and recent transactions, review royalty and streaming analytics by track, DSP, and territory, and open or reply to support tickets. Write actions such as creating a support ticket or replying to a ticket require an explicit confirmation step before anything changes.

defaultPrompt: How many releases do I have on Distrofy?
What is my Distrofy wallet balance and recent royalties?
Summarize my streaming analytics and top tracks.
